names: Partial polyglycerol esters of polycondensed fatty acids of castor oil
display_name: E498 (Partial polyglycerol esters of polycondensed fatty acids of castor oil)

more_info.overview: This historical group name describes partial polyglycerol esters of polycondensed fatty acids from castor oil. A related current specification, polyglycerol polyricinoleate, combines polyglycerol with condensed castor-oil fatty acids for emulsifying applications. The supplied broad designation was not confirmed as an exact equivalent of that specified preparation. Consequently, its identity description does not transfer E476's approval, intake limit or food examples to this entry.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
